Subject: Next step: security review for Redwood POC

Hi Olga and Marissa,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team was impressed. Before we spin up the pilot, our security and procurement teams need a short technical review to validate data controls and deployment options. Goal: 45 min sync where our security engineer, procurement lead, and your security/SE can walk through architecture, SOC2 scoping, and any data residency questions.

Availability from our side: Wed 5/5 between 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 5/6 after 13:00 PT. Please confirm who from Redwood should join (security + SE preferred). I've attached a quick intake (stratussys-security-intake.csv) with attendees and initial questions.

Thanks,
Alex Duncan
Security Lead, StratusSys
alex.duncan@stratussys.com
Attachment: stratussys-security-intake.csv (CSV stub)

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear availability. We'll plan to have Redwood Security (Vivek) and an SE (Dev) on the call. Marissa (AE) and I will also join to cover scope and next steps.

Proposed slots from Redwood:
- Wed 5/5 10:30–11:15 PT (30–45 min)
- Thu 5/6 13:30–14:15 PT

Please confirm which option works and whether procurement or legal prefer a separate follow-up. Vivek, Dev — can you confirm and I will lock the calendar and send a Zoom link? Also flag any pre-reads you want attached to the invite.

—Olga

Thanks, Olga — I can do both proposed slots but prefer Wed 5/5 10:30 PT. I'll lead the security segment and can cover SOC 2 scope, data flows, encryption, and KMS options.

Attachments I'll add to the invite: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (brief), internal architecture diagram (reference link included in the calendar). If Alex's team can paste any high-level architecture or specific compliance items in the calendar description that would help me prep.

Also quick note: if StratusSys requires proof-of-compliance artifacts ahead of the call, we can provide a SOC2 summary and network diagrams. For anything that needs legal review (DPA language), we should loop Legal after the session.
